provenance.construction: Two-block group algebra code over the dihedral group D144 (order 288): HX = [L[a] L[b]], HZ = [R[b] R[a]] with element-index supports a=[145, 217, 226, 261], b=[59, 92, 147, 165, 207, 254] in the left/right regular representation; n = 2|G|, max check weight 10.
provenance.notes: Found by a MAP-Elites search over non-abelian 2BGA codes gated by an escalating distance ladder; the reported d is the minimum over multi-seed randomized information-set searches at 200k, 2M and 20M iterations (values agreed across all rungs), with the recorded per-side witnesses extracted at the 20M budget.
